summary.text: Bryce Berry is a Democratic state representative from Georgia House District 56 who has served since January 2025 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
A teacher and Morehouse College graduate, he has also been president of the Young Democrats of Georgia.

paragraphs.text: Berry was born in St. Louis, Missouri, and earned a bachelor's degree from Morehouse College in 2023.
His career experience includes working as a teacher, and in a 2024 Ballotpedia survey he described himself as a middle school math teacher.

He served as a state youth leader for the 2020 Biden-Harris campaign and as deputy political director for the 2022 Coordinated Campaign, and as of his 2024 campaign he was president of the Young Democrats of Georgia.
Berry succeeded Mesha Mainor in District 56, assuming office on January 13, 2025, and advanced from the Democratic primary on May 19, 2026.
For 2025-2026 he was assigned to the House Economic Development and Tourism Committee, the Information and Audits Committee and the State Planning and Community Affairs Committee.
In the 2024 survey, Berry named education reform, economic development, accessible healthcare and affordable housing as issues his campaign addresses.
